title: SPEC §3 expectations E1–E4 + E6 (paired random reference)
note: Headline rows (E1 … E4, E6) = worst of their sub-checks (E1.<tag>, E2.*, E3.<tag>.<cell>, E4.<tag>, E6.<parent>.random_flat / .delta_below_random / .high_fraction — the last only when the grid carries 98 / 99 %). E2 is evaluated on the SPEC grid (x ≤ 50 %) whatever the grid; E1 reports fractions without a prediction as 'no prediction'. flag 'leak?' = realised sieve recall or behaviour better than its ROC predicts (SPEC §5 template-family leak). E6 is NOT RUN when the random tags are absent.
